evals.expected_output: Lists plan_auth-tokens then plan_audit-log in that order; excludes plan_dark-mode (draft), plan_rate-limit (implemented), plan_billing (depends on a draft) with reasons; checks for to-tickets/code-review; writes nothing.
assertions: lists plan_auth-tokens before plan_audit-log
excludes plan_dark-mode with reason 'draft'
excludes plan_rate-limit with reason 'implemented'
excludes plan_billing with reason 'depends on draft'
mentions the to-tickets / code-review prerequisite check and that to-tickets is human-run
writes no files in the repo (STATE.md unchanged, no worktrees)

assertions: creates docs/plan_<slug>.md whose first three lines are title, Status:, Depends on:
Depends on names plan_audit-log
cites src/audit.ts with current behaviour
has numbered decisions each with a reason
has Not in scope, Tests, and ordered Implementation sections
writes no code under src/
